temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia appears more withdrawn than usual during shifts; when Jose asks, she says it is personal stuff and thanks him, but gives no details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is usually vibrant and socially engaged at work; Jose has no specific concern about her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Her withdrawn behavior and vague admission suggest something personal is troubling her, though she is private about it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia may be dealing with a personal problem; she appreciates Jose's offer to listen but has not disclosed details.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and empathetic; cautious about not pushing.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Be available to listen and support Patricia without prying.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments; she later confirms she is overwhelmed with bills and is open to discussing financial planning or budgeting.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia seems troubled by personal issues but is private; Jose does not know the specific cause.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He learns that her trouble includes financial stress and that she may welcome practical help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is financially stressed and overwhelmed by bills, and she is receptive to his offer of financial-planning or budgeting support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Deepened concern and sympathy; helpful and motivated.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer and potentially help her with budgeting or financial planning when she is ready.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia reassures Jose that his financial-planning offer was not prying; she is grateful and says it is good to know she has someone to turn to.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is financially stressed and may be open to help, but Jose worries his offer might have crossed a boundary or felt intrusive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Her reassurance resolves his worry about overstepping and confirms that his support is welcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: His concern and offers of help are appreciated, not intrusive; Patricia trusts him as a supportive friend, though he should still respect her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worry or uncertainty before the reassurance; relief and reassurance afterward.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue to support her as a friend while respecting her privacy and boundaries.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia responds casually that everything is going well and she plans a quiet weekend; she thanks Jose and says she will keep his offer in mind, without sharing more.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his support and does not think he was prying; Jose can be a supportive friend while respecting boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Her brief, general response suggests she appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately rather than discuss them now.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia values his support but wants space or privacy; Jose should remain available without pressing for details.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Understanding and respectful concern; perhaps slightly reserved.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Give her space while keeping a friendly, low-pressure offer to chat or help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose checks in with Patricia; she says she is busy but handling things, thanks him for checking in, and says his support is great. Jose reaffirms he is available to help, even just for coffee.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates support but prefers to handle personal or financial issues privately; Jose should be supportive without pushing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirms and updates. His ongoing check-ins are welcomed, and she feels supported while managing her situation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is managing her issues, appreciates Jose's regular supportive presence, and will reach out if she needs help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue regular, low-pressure check-ins and offer practical help or coffee while respecting her independence.
